name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Ames, Bungalow, and Quinn belong to different classes.
Either Piper goes with Ames or Piper goes with Greenhouse.
Either Bungalow goes with Frost or Quinn goes with Dunn.
If Bungalow does not go with Dunn, then either Frost goes with Piper or Iris goes with Dunn (but not both).
Between Kira and Mona, one goes with Ames and the other with Nash.
Kira, Mona, and Piper go with Ames, Greenhouse, and Workshop, in some order.
Either Greenhouse goes with Kira, or Pavilion goes with Mona — but not both.

chain: Start by assuming Dunn goes with Bungalow.
Bungalow goes with Dunn, so Frost can't go with Bungalow.
Dunn goes with Bungalow, but Quinn doesn't, so Dunn doesn't go with Quinn.
…but now the clue “Either Bungalow goes with Frost or Quinn goes with Dunn” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dunn does not go with Bungalow.
